sentences.text:
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH --------
For the Petitioner : Ms. Neetu Singh, Advocate For the State : Mr. A. K. Dey, A.P.P For the Opp.
Party No.2 : Mr. S. K. Chamaria, Advocate --------

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 3141 of 2021, for the offences under Sections 406, 420, 323 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Shri Suresh Oraon, learned Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad.

It was submitted that after enquiry, the learned Court below found the prima facie case to be true against the petitioner for the offence under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code and process has been issued for his appearance under Section 204 Cr.P.C.
This anticipatory bail arises out of complaint case.
The offence alleged is compoundable and punishable for the period of seven years.
There is no reasonable apprehension that the petitioner will be taken into custody.

The petitioner is directed to surrender before the Court below within two weeks from today and the learned Court below shall dispose of his bail application on the same day in light of the direction given by this court in Birendra Jha @ Virendra Jha Vs State of Jharkhand as reported in Nandan Kumar Agarwal vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ..... .... ... on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146606454/
1 [2001(2)JLJR76] . Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application stands disposed of.
